newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Power Grid to announce power plants tender.
newsitem.headline: Polish Power Grid to announce power plants tender.

text.p: The Polish Power Grid (PSE) plans to announce a tender for a construction of eight small power plants to supply extra energy during peak hours, the company's deputy president said on Friday.
He said that despite the overall 35 percent surplus in Poland's power generation capacity, small gas or hydroelectric plans which would cover temporary shortages.

"We consider announcing in a few months' a tender for domestic and foreign independent power producers for the construction of eight small peak hours energy plants," Ryszard Frydrychowski told a news conference.
He would not say what would be the total cost of the project.

He said that Poland's blueprint for the energy sector reform and privatisation saw PSE, Poland's second-largest company in terms of sales, partially privatised with the state likely maintaining a majority stake.
